Send to X3: settings
Edit the five Text actions below. (When you add this shortcut from a file, the Shortcuts app asks for them.)
1. Ingest URL: the "Address" on the Setup page of the Send to X3 app, like http://192.168.1.50:8765/api/v1/ingest (use the IP address, not a .local name). 2. Ingest token: the "Ingest token" from the same page. 3. Home Wi-Fi names, separated by commas, spelled exactly as on the phone (capitals matter). On these networks the shortcut sends directly; elsewhere it sends an email. 4. Ingest email address: the address the app reads mail from (for example yourname+x3secret@gmail.com). Leave it empty if you do not use email. 5. Mode: auto (direct at home, email elsewhere), http (always direct) or email (always email). Anything else counts as auto.

What was shared: a Safari page gives its address, title and selected text. A link on its own, or a domain name like example.com, is sent as the address. Anything else (text, an article, or the clipboard when run without input) is sent as text, and the app finds the links in it. SharedLink is the link an email starts with.
Share a web page, a link or some text to Send to X3, or copy something and run it again.
Route: http and email always use that route. Otherwise (auto) send directly when the current Wi-Fi network is one of the home networks, and by email everywhere else.
Send directly to the Send to X3 app and show the title it saved.
Open the shortcut and fill in the ingest URL at the top.
Send to X3 is not set up
Open the shortcut and fill in the ingest token at the top.
Send to X3 is not set up

￼
Check the ingest URL and token at the top of the shortcut.
Send by email: the app picks it up from the mailbox it watches.
To send from outside your home Wi-Fi, fill in the ingest email address at the top of the shortcut. To always send directly, set the mode to http.
Send to X3: no email address
Emailed. It shows up on the X3 after the app reads the mailbox.
Send to X3 address: the ingest URL from the app's Setup page, like http://192.168.1.50:8765/api/v1/ingest
Send to X3 ingest token (from the app's Setup page)
Your home Wi-Fi network names, separated by commas (capitals matter). On these the shortcut sends directly; elsewhere it sends an email.
Email address the Send to X3 app reads, for sending when away from home. Leave empty to send over Wi-Fi only.
Mode: auto (direct at home, email elsewhere), http (always direct) or email (always email)
